claim: agentgateway added an explicit inferenceRouting destinationMode setting so operators can choose between validating EPP-selected destinations against local endpoint data or trusting them directly.
stance_target: agentgateway can be extended to route to non-Kubernetes-pod backends selected by an EPP
scope_conditions: agentgateway proxy, inferenceRouting service backends, merged into main Apr 24 2026
quoted_support: Use EPP-selected destinations directly for inferenceRouting service backends when `destinationMode: passthrough` is configured. Keep the default destination mode endpoint-validated so existing configs retain local endpoint-derived behavior.

claim: In passthrough mode, agentgateway does not require mirrored local Kubernetes workload/endpoint data at all -- the standalone EPP fully owns endpoint discovery.
stance_target: standalone EPP + agentgateway passthrough removes the Kubernetes Endpoints dependency for backend discovery
quoted_support: Use the destination returned by inference routing directly for service backends so standalone EPP can own endpoint discovery without mirrored local workload data.

claim: The passthrough destination-trust change was paired with a separate, explicitly-tracked fail-open concern rather than being solved in the same PR.
stance_target: maintainers' security/fail-open trade-off deliberation for standalone EPP routing
quoted_support: Support fail-open fallback for standalone EPP inference routing #1661

claim: Passthrough mode was end-to-end tested against a companion GIE PR adding standalone agentgateway proxy support, tying the agentgateway-side change to a specific upstream integration PR.
